report.explanation: Gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.001, p95 80ms, no dependency timeouts, INFO 200 logs. Only one gateway trace shows an ERROR calling order (921ms), suggesting downstream latency, but no order-side evidence exists. Current facts are insufficient to bound a root cause; hand off for downstream telemetry.
missing_evidence: Order service traces/metrics/logs for the same window to confirm or refute downstream latency or errors
Gateway error-rate and p95 metrics over a longer window; current 0.001 error rate and p95 80ms contradict the alert
Dependency timeout and db_pool_waiter detail for order, payment, inventory, postgresql, redis
Logs capturing the ERROR span status seen in gateway traces (logs show only INFO 200)
